analysis.reasonEn: Shifted from a sell recommendation for the past 3 sessions to a wait-and-see approach today. RSI confirmed exit from oversold territory, rising from 32.6 to 43.9. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the current price of $137.91 compared to the 5-day low of $127.65. Approaching the swing support at $137.52.
